```{r}
fitted_k <- function(k){
    mod_k_T <- get_model_k(k, T)
    mod_k_F <- get_model_k(k, F)
    mod_k_T$fitted.values - mod_k_F$fitted.values
}
```

```{r}
f2 <- fitted_k(2)
```

```{r}
summary(get_model_k(1.5, T))
summary(get_model_k(1.5, F))
```


```{r}
trues <- which(tonal_df$complex_tonal == 1)
```

```{r}
sort(f2[trues])
hist(f2[trues])
```
